name: aquaconnect-mvp-repo-root
description: This is a Flutter app repo (see pubspec.yaml) — the deployable Node/Express API lives in server/. This package.json exists only so Railway's Railpack builder detects a Node app at the repo root when the service's Root Directory isn't set to server/. If you set Root Directory to "server" in the Railway service settings instead, this file isn't needed for that service.
